description:
Memo Calendar displays a yearly calendar, memo markers, and weather.

Memo setup: right-click the project, choose 'Open in Explorer', then create a memo file named for the current year, for example 'Memo-2026.txt'. Each line should use this format: month-day=type=text. Supported types are holiday, event, and item. Example: 1-1=holiday=New Year.

Weather setup: run LocalLink, set your IPInfo and OpenWeather tokens there, then keep LocalLink running. Location, weather, and theme data are provided by LocalLink. Unit chooses Celsius or Fahrenheit.
title: Memo Calendar
